{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the trial data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_value = -999.0

# Identify rows with sentinel value
sentinel_rows = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] == sentinel_value]

# Count how many rows have sentinel value
n_sentinel = len(sentinel_rows)

# Print the count and a sample of those rows
n_sentinel, sentinel_rows.head()"}
